newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Motor union, management reach agreement.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Motor union, management reach agreement.

text.p: Union and management negotiators at Daewoo Motor's car plant in Bupyong have reached an agreement which will be put to a union vote on Friday, company and union officials said on Tuesday.
"An agreement has been reached with the management and the plant's operations are now back to normal," Lee Yong-shin, a union leader, said by telephone.
Union workers at the plant walked out for a full day last Wednesday and for four working hours on each of the next two days to press their demand in this year's wage negotiations.
The union had demanded a 9.7 percent rise in basic salary, compared with the management's proposal of 5.45 percent.
Both Lee and a company spokesman declined to give details of the agreement.
